meta.title: Model Failover Manager
meta.description: Model picker dialog with routing groups: a model that keeps failing hands the turn to the next usable model in its group. A free-channel tab installs six plugins — Our Free Model, CodeArts, WorkBuddy, Trae, Qoder and Providers Hub — covering 23 free platforms from Huawei Cloud CodeArts and Tencent CodeBuddy to TRAE, Cline, MiniMax, Zhipu ZCode, Gemini and iFlytek AStudio, plus a metrics dashboard and error-retry settings.
